title: An ordinary loan repayment credits LOAN_PORTFOLIO 250.00 and FEES_RECEIVABLE 20.00 then debits the 270.00 total to the resolved fund source 4 exactly ONCE (loan 18 L93)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the journal entry an ORDINARY repayment posted under createJournalEntriesForLoanRepayments, on the Tier-D MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits, product LP1 / product 6, loan 18 not charged off) at repayment transaction L93. request.repayment_journal.portions transcribes the loan read-back's repayment transaction id 93 (externalId 13979a89-4222-41cf-b3c8-de2a41219a08, type loanTransactionType.repayment, paymentDetailData.paymentType.id 11 AUTOPAY): principalPortion 250.0 -> "25000", feeChargesPortion 20.0 -> "2000", interest/penalty/overpayment 0 and omitted. request.repayment_journal.accounts is the accepted create request product-mappings/create-request-LP1.json's accountingMappings with the fund source RESOLVED through the payment channel: loanPortfolioAccountId 10, receivableInterest/Fee/PenaltyAccountId 7, overpaymentLiabilityAccountId 18, fundSourceAccountId 4; the ONLY paymentChannelToFundSourceMappings entry is paymentTypeId 1 -> 17, so paymentType 11 (AUTOPAY) has no channel mapping and resolves to the product fund source 4. expect.repayment_journal_legs is a TRANSCRIPTION of the three L93 legs in id order from the journal-entries read-back: JE 204 CREDIT account 10 250.00, JE 205 CREDIT account 7 20.00, JE 206 DEBIT account 4 270.00. THIS VECTOR GRADES ONE PROPERTY: an ordinary repayment CREDITS each non-zero portion to its slot account, MERGING portions that share a credit account at the first slot's position, then DEBITs the total exactly ONCE to the resolved fund source, credits first and the single debit last. The two credits here (principal 25000, fee 2000) share NO account (10 vs 7), so the merged-credit branch is not exercised; what this vector DOES discriminate is a port that posts one FUND_SOURCE debit per credited portion instead of the one total debit: that port emits two debits (25000 and 2000) and the leg count grows from three to four while the one-debit invariant fails, whereas the oracle posts the single 27000 debit JE 206. A port that credits the fee to the wrong slot or debits an account other than 4 also moves a leg. WHAT THIS VECTOR DOES NOT GRADE: a merged positive interest/fee/penalty credit (the interest and penalty portions are zero); the overpayment portion (zero here — the loan-19 L98 vector grades it); the excluded branches (goodwill credit, transfer, isIncomeFromFee, charge refund, tax) have no input and are not expressible. The journal-entries read-back holds only these three legs for L93: no later reversal of L93 is present, so only the original posting's legs are transcribed. Nothing was computed by this promotion: every portion, every account and every expected leg is read directly from the committed files.
